description: DiligenceOps: read a terms or policy page (a public HTTPS url, read once with GET) or supplied text, up to 512 KB, and return a signed report on whether fee, refund, cancellation and ownership clauses are present or missing, with match counts, heading lines and up to three brief quotes per clause with their offsets. POST /api/terms-evidence-check. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence/.

inputSchema.description: Exactly one of url or text.

url.description: Public HTTPS terms or policy page. Read once with GET, no redirects, up to 512 KB.

text.description: Terms or policy text, plain or HTML, up to 512 KB.

name: wever_terms-evidence-check
title: Terms evidence check
